Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Mejika - Genchou.name: Genghis Khan II: Clan of the Gray Wolf
Aoki Ookami to Shiroki Mejika - Genchou.summary: "Genghis Khan II: Clan of the Gray Wolf" was released in 1992, the third in the series and the second to be released outside Japan. The wolves of the Great Plains become the rulers of the world. Engage in culturally rich battles using fighters, horsemen, elephant riders and more.

Psychic Storm.name: Psychic Storm
Psychic Storm.summary: Psychic Storm is a vertically scrolling shoot-em-up in which the player takes the role of four characters who must protect Neo Hong Kong City from an assault by vicious insectoid aliens.
